svg.title: pfSense firewall network architecture
svg.desc: Top-down network diagram: Internet at top flows through pfSense firewall with pfBlockerNG and DNSBL filtering, then into a LAN switch, then to Windows VM, Ubuntu VM, and a monitoring node at the bottom. Threat feeds shown at the very bottom.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What is the WAN interface in pfSense?')
sendPrompt('How does pfSense work as a firewall and router?')
sendPrompt('What does pfBlockerNG do and how does it block IPs?')
sendPrompt('What is DNSBL domain filtering in pfSense?')
sendPrompt('What firewall rules were set up in this pfSense lab?')
g.text: Block port 22 (SSH) — prevent remote access attacks
Block port 23 (Telnet) — allow only HTTP / HTTPS

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How is the internal LAN network configured in this lab?')
sendPrompt('What was the Windows 10 VM used for in this pfSense lab?')
sendPrompt('What monitoring tools were used in this pfSense lab?')
sendPrompt('What was the Ubuntu Linux VM used for in this lab?')
sendPrompt('What threat intelligence feeds does pfBlockerNG use?')
g.text: Spamhaus · Emerging Threats · Feodo Tracker · Blocklist.de
